title: Photograph your sheet
intro: Worksheet, textbook page or notebook – as a photo or PDF. I'll make practice from it.
tip: Tip: whole page, good light, from above.
privacy: Photos are deleted at the latest 7 days after reading.
limit: One sheet can have at most {{max}} photos.

permission.camera: LearnBuddy isn't allowed to use the camera yet. You can allow it in Settings – or choose a picture from your photos.

error.camera: The camera didn't open just now. You can also choose a picture from your photos.
error.library: Your photos didn't open just now. Try again.
error.prepare_one: One picture couldn't be opened. Pick another one.
error.prepare_other: {{count}} pictures couldn't be opened. Pick other ones.
error.upload_file: Photo {{index}} is gone. Remove it and take it again.
error.left: Your sheet didn't arrive. Please photograph it again.
error.left_kept: Your sheet hasn't arrived yet. Your photos are waiting on Buddy's screen – send them again from there.

homework.title: Photograph your homework
homework.intro: I'll help you step by step – you'll find the answer yourself.

quality.blurry_tip: Hold the phone still and tap the sheet on the screen to focus.
quality.dark_tip: Move to the light or turn a light on – without the phone's shadow on the sheet.
quality.washed_out: The writing on photo {{index}} is hard to see.
quality.washed_out_tip: Too bright or glare: tilt the phone a little, away from the lamp.
quality.small_tip: I can hardly read small print like this. Better take the sheet with the camera.
quality.tilted_tip: Lay the sheet straight and hold the phone right above it, not at an angle.

again.title: Take it again
again.intro: Only what was missing – the rest is already done. Make sure the whole page is in the photo.
again.added: Page sent. Once it's read, its questions join this sheet.

draft.title: Your photos haven't been sent yet

files.pick_label: Choose from files – PDF or image
files.drop: Drop it here – I take photos and PDFs.
files.error: Your files didn't open just now. Please try again.
files.unsupported_one: One file isn't an image or a PDF – I'll leave it out.
files.unsupported_other: {{count}} files aren't images or PDFs – I'll leave them out.
files.too_large: The PDF is too big – {{max}} MB at most. Better take a photo of the sheet.

share.nothing: Send me a photo or PDF of your sheet – I can't read text or links here.
share.signed_out: Please sign in first – then share the sheet with LearnBuddy again.

corrected.title: Photograph your test
corrected.intro: The marked test with the corrections. We practise exactly what was marked – I don’t keep grades or points.

today.title: What was today?
today.intro: Photograph today’s notes from your exercise book. I’ll make a few short questions for tomorrow morning.
